settings.shade_help_label: Which razor line suits you? Compare below.

settings.label: What is good about it
settings.text: A metal handle with real weight, a head that pivots to follow your jaw, five blades set at stepped heights, a lubricating strip and a trimmer on the back for sideburns and edges.

settings.label: In the box
settings.text: One handle in the colour you pick and one cartridge, or four if you choose the larger pack. Refills only fit handles from the same line.

settings.label: How to swap the cartridge
settings.text: Press the button on the handle, the used cartridge pops off, then click a fresh one on until it seats. Rinse the blades after each shave and swap once the glide feels rough.

settings.heading: Gel, blades and balm
settings.text: Add all three and take $1 off each item. Better together, and about $3 back.

settings.quote: “A single cartridge outlasted a full month of daily shaves.”

settings.text: A lubricating strip softens hair as the blades pass, the pivot keeps contact on curves, the trimmer handles edges, and a push button ejects the cartridge without touching the blades.

settings.text: The cartridge rocks forward and back so the blades keep contact around the chin and the neck.

settings.title: Razor Pro cartridges
settings.text: Five blades. They click onto Razor Pro handles and nothing else.

settings.title: Razor Classic cartridges
settings.text: Four blades. They click onto Razor Classic handles and nothing else.

settings.title: Not sure what you own?
settings.text: Count the blades on the cartridge: five means Pro, four means Classic.

settings.heading: Worth the upgrade? Side by side

settings.title: Blades and head
settings.text: Pro: five blades with a pivot. Classic: four blades, fixed head.

settings.title: Handle
settings.text: Pro: weighted metal. Classic: light recycled plastic.

settings.title: Cartridge life
settings.text: Pro: up to 21 shaves. Classic: about 16 shaves.

settings.title: Cost per cartridge
settings.text: In an eight-pack, Pro averages about $3 and Classic about $2.

settings.label: What separates Pro from Classic?
settings.text: Pro adds a fifth blade, a pivoting head and a metal handle, and each cartridge lasts longer. Classic keeps the price lower.

settings.label: Will refills from the other line fit?
settings.text: No. Each line has its own cartridge shape, so buy refills that match the number of blades on your handle.

settings.label: How do I change the cartridge?
settings.text: Press the release button, let the old cartridge drop, and push a new one on until it clicks.

settings.label: How often should I replace it?
settings.text: When the glide gets rough or you notice tugging. Most people land between two and four months.

settings.title: No more neck irritation
settings.text: I used to dread shaving under the jaw. The pivot kept the blades flat and I had no redness the next morning.

settings.title: One cartridge, six weeks
settings.text: I shave every other day and a single cartridge carried me through. Replacement cost is lower than my old brand.
